title: Summer Property Hunt: Mid-Market Digital Campaign for First-Time Buyers
objective: Capture 25–35 qualified property inquiry leads from first-time homebuyers during school holidays; drive site traffic 40% YoY; establish ZYNTH client as the 'first-time buyer expert' in SG real estate.
target_audience: First-time homebuyers aged 28–42, household income SGD 120k–250k, actively researching condos/HDB resale in July; parents planning with school holidays.
key_activities: Audit current website SEO gaps (keyword coverage, schema markup, page speed); implement 8–12 high-intent keywords ('new condo July 2024', 'HDB resale first-time buyer') with content lift.

Execute paid Google & Meta campaign: 3 ad variations (rational: loan comparison; emotional: 'your dream home'; disruptive: 'sold in 7 days') across Search, Display Remarketing, and Instagram/Facebook feed.

Produce 2 short-form video assets (15–30s each): 'First 5 Steps to Buying' + 'July Market Pulse' for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels; 5 organic social posts (carousel posts, testimonials, market tips).
Weekly paid performance audit; reallocate budget to best-performing creative weekly; A/B test landing page CTAs (lead form vs. WhatsApp button).
kpis: 25–35 qualified leads (lead form submissions + WhatsApp inquiries); target CAC SGD 280–340.
15% CTR on paid ad creatives; ROAS 2.8–3.2 (break-even ~2.0).
40% increase in website sessions YoY (July vs. June baseline); 35% avg. landing page conversion rate.
2 video assets ≥ 50k combined views; 8 organic posts ≥ 12% engagement rate.
zynth_services: SEO (technical audit + keyword strategy)
Paid Ads (Google Search, Meta, Display Remarketing)
Content Creation (2 short-form videos)
Social Media Management (5 organic posts, audience engagement)
Analytics & Reporting
why_now: July school holidays drive family-focused property research; first-time buyers have annual bonus liquidity (mid-year) and longer decision timelines. Competitive ad CPM stabilises mid-year; organic search volume for 'new condo', 'HDB resale' peaks July–August.
deliverables: 1 technical SEO audit report + 8–12 keyword implementation plan
2 short-form video assets (script, production, post-production, 2 platform exports each)
3 Google Ads campaign setups (Search, Display Remarketing, Performance Max) with daily budget allocation
2 Facebook/Instagram campaign setups with 3 creative variants each
5 organic social posts (captions, image/video, scheduling)
6 weekly performance reports (leads, CAC, ROAS, spend, CTR) + 1 final campaign summary with recommendations

title: Urban Oasis: PropTech Startup Product Launch Event (120–150 pax)

target_audience: Real estate agents & brokers (60 pax), PropTech investors & VCs (15 pax), property journalists & bloggers (10 pax), industry partners (15 pax).
key_activities: Host live product demo + Q&A on innovative stage with integrated LED screens; feature 2 testimonials from early-adopter agents (pre-recorded or live).
Networking lounge with branded cocktail bar (signature mocktail + alcoholic options); light-bite stations highlighting sustainable catering.
Interactive 'Valuation Demo Booths' (3 stations, rotating 20-min slots) where agents test the tool in real-time with ZYNTH staff guiding.
Live social media coverage: Instagram Stories (6–8 posts live), TikTok clips (2–3 viral-angle shorts), LinkedIn pulse posts from founder; 1 on-site photographer capturing candid + formal shots.
Post-event media outreach: press release + 3 journalist briefings; video recap (2–3 min) published within 48 hours.
kpis: 120–150 confirmed attendees (target 85% attendance); post-event survey ≥ 4.2/5 NPS.
40+ qualified B2B leads (captured via sign-in + booth interactions); follow-up email open rate ≥ 35%.
3–5 media mentions (tier-2 publications: e27, PropertyGuru, BT Investor); 500+ LinkedIn impressions on event recap post.
2–3 min video recap ≥ 8k views (YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok combined); 6–8 Instagram Stories reach 1.2k–1.8k accounts.

Branding & Design (event collateral: backdrop, banners, booth signage; printed invitations)
Photography & Video (live capture + post-event 2–3 min recap)
Social Media Management (live event coverage: Instagram Stories, TikTok, LinkedIn posts)
PR & Media Outreach (press release, journalist briefings, follow-up)

title: Back-to-School Property Upgrade: Parent-Focused Influencer Campaign
objective: Drive awareness of 'family-friendly' new condo launches (2–3 bedrooms, near good schools) among affluent parents aged 32–48; generate 18–22 qualified leads; achieve 2.5M+ combined reach across 6 micro/mid-tier influencers.
target_audience: Affluent parents aged 32–48 (household income SGD 180k+), seeking family-sized properties near top schools; active on Instagram, TikTok; lifestyle & parenting content consumers.
key_activities: Partner with 6 carefully-selected lifestyle/parenting influencers (300k–800k followers each, 6–9% engagement rate); each creates 2 authentic pieces (1 Instagram Reel, 1 TikTok, OR 1 carousel post + 1 Stories takeover).
Develop 3 content angles: 'Why We Upgraded to a Family Condo', 'School Commute Hack', 'Our New Neighbourhood Tour'; provide loose brief + let creators own the narrative.
Negotiate affiliate/performance bonus: base payment SGD 1,500–2,500/influencer + SGD 50 bonus per qualified lead they refer (transparent tracking via unique promo code or link).
Coordinate 1 group 'condo tour' content day (4–5 hours); influencers film on-site, capture behind-the-scenes, generate authentic user-generated content (UGC).
Seed 3 behind-the-scenes 'making-of' short clips on ZYNTH's own channels; amplify influencer content via paid boost (SGD 2k budget) to reach non-followers.
kpis: 2.5M+ combined reach; 8–12% engagement rate on influencer content (higher than creator baseline).
18–22 qualified leads attributed to influencer campaign (tracked via unique codes/links); lead-to-site visit ratio ≥ 35%.
3–5 pieces of content ≥ 100k views each; 1 'breakout' post ≥ 300k views.
Post-campaign sentiment analysis ≥ 85% positive; mention of property name/brand in 80%+ of influencer captions.
zynth_services: Influencer Marketing (talent sourcing, negotiation, brief development, performance tracking)
Content Creation (1 group tour day coordination + 3 UGC editing/clips)
Social Media Management (seeding, scheduling, engagement monitoring during campaign)
Paid Ads (SGD 2k amplification spend on top-performing influencer content)
Analytics & Reporting (lead attribution, engagement tracking, sentiment analysis)
why_now: Back-to-school season (late July–August) is peak family property research window; parents are motivated by school choices and want to secure housing before term starts; influencer audiences are highly engaged and planning summer moves.
deliverables: 6 influencer contracts (signed, with clear deliverable specs, payment terms, lead attribution tracking)
3 creative briefs (1 per content angle) with talking points, hashtags, and performance expectations
1 'condo tour' day coordination (location scouting, influencer scheduling, production support, equipment/lighting kit)
12 unique influencer content pieces (6 creators × 2 pieces each: Reels, TikToks, carousels, Stories takeovers)
3 ZYNTH-owned UGC shorts (15–30s, editing, captions, optimised for TikTok/Instagram/YouTube)
1 influencer content amplification campaign (SGD 2k budget allocation, 6 placements on top 3 performing posts)
1 lead attribution tracker (unique codes/links per influencer, daily log of qualified leads)
1 post-campaign report (reach, engagement, leads, sentiment, cost-per-lead, ROI vs. benchmark)

title: Urban Living Expo 2024: Multi-Developer Trade Show & Brand Activation
objective: Position a consortium of 3–4 real estate developers as unified 'urban living innovators'; drive 500+ qualified foot traffic; secure 80+ qualified leads; generate 15+ media features; build brand authority through 3-day expo presence.
target_audience: Property buyers (1st-time to upgraders), investors, interior designers, architects, facilities managers; SG & regional (MY, ID expat) investors aged 28–55; income SGD 120k+.
key_activities: Design & build 1 premium 400 sq ft consortium booth (modular, reusable; features 2 large LED screens, interactive 3D property model, lounge seating for 20 pax consultations).
Staff booth with 8–10 trained sales agents + 2 designer/architect consultants; daily shift rotation (3 shifts × 3 days).
Host 3 mini-seminars on booth stage: 'Investment Trends 2024', 'Designing Your Dream Home', 'Financing First Property'; each 45 min with Q&A; 40–60 pax per session.
Run daily raffle (booth visitors enter; prize: SGD 1,500 interior design voucher, financed property tours); daily announcement; social seeding.
Deploy 2–3 roaming brand ambassadors (costumed/branded gear) to drive foot traffic from adjacent booths; distribute 500 branded collateral (brochures, postcards, QR codes linking to lead form).
Live social: Instagram Stories (3–5 daily), 1 TikTok reel per day showing 'expo highlights', booth energy; daily LinkedIn post from founder/MD.
kpis: 500+ foot traffic (captured via QR code scans + manual sign-in); 80+ qualified leads (property type, budget, timeline logged).
Lead-to-inquiry conversion: ≥ 35% of 80 leads follow up within 7 days; 12–15 site visits booked.
15+ media mentions (online publications, real estate blogs, local press); booth photo/video appear in ≥ 5 articles.
3 seminars: 40–60 pax each; post-seminar survey ≥ 4.3/5 rating; 25–30 attendees capture contact details for nurture.
Expo coverage: 200+ Instagram Stories reach, 50k+ TikTok impressions, 3k+ LinkedIn impressions; branded hashtag #UrbanLiving2024 achieves 800+ posts.

Branding & Design (booth 3D rendering, collateral design, printed brochures/postcards, signage)
Photography & Video (daily booth coverage, 3–5 min recap video, seminar documentation)
Social Media Management (live Instagram Stories, daily TikToks, LinkedIn posts, hashtag seeding)
PR & Media Outreach (press release, media invite list, on-site interviews, post-expo follow-up)
why_now: July is optimal for mid-year trade shows (post-school-holiday rush, budget cycles reset); summer holidays mean higher foot traffic and leisure time for property hunting; real estate investment momentum peaks mid-year before H2 market slowdown.
deliverables: 1 booth design & 3D rendering (400 sq ft, modular fabrication, electrical/AV schematic)
1 custom booth build (fabrication, setup, AV installation, contingency support)
Booth collateral: 500 printed brochures, 300 postcards (with QR code), 200 branded giveaways (tote bags or pens), signage (banner 3m×2m, backlit LED)
3 interactive assets: 2 large LED screens (rental + content), 1 3D property model (physical or AR enabled), lounge seating (rental: 20 pax capacity)
Staff training: 1 briefing doc (talking points, objection handling, lead capture protocol) + 1 live briefing session (2 hours)
2 roaming brand ambassadors (costumed, briefed, 3-day deployment)

3 mini-seminars: 1 script/deck per seminar, speaker prep, AV coordination, post-session lead capture
Daily photography (300+ images) + 1 post-expo recap video (3–5 min, edited, 3 platform exports)
9 Instagram Stories (3 daily over 3 days), 3 TikTok reels (1 daily), 3 LinkedIn posts (founder/MD authored)
1 press release + media invite list + on-site journalist briefing

title: PropTech Thought Leadership: Executive Content & Personal Branding Series
objective: Establish CEO/Founder as SG's go-to voice on real estate innovation & sustainability; generate 25+ qualified B2B/investor leads; grow personal LinkedIn following 40% YoY; secure 1–2 speaking opportunities at tier-1 industry events.
target_audience: Property industry decision-makers, VCs/angel investors, C-suite executives (real estate, fintech, construction); LinkedIn audiences aged 35–60, income SGD 200k+; active on LinkedIn, attend industry conferences.
key_activities: Develop 8-week executive content calendar: 1 long-form LinkedIn article (1,200–1,500 words) every 2 weeks; topics: 'Automation in Property Valuation', 'Sustainability & New Builds', 'Regional Expansion Playbook', 'AI & Agent Productivity'.
Produce 4 short-form thought leadership videos (5–8 min each, edited, captioned): 1 on each major article theme; feature CEO on camera; distribute on LinkedIn, YouTube, and company blog.
Host 1 live 'Fireside Chat' with a respected industry figure (e.g., developer CEO, investor) on Zoom/LinkedIn Live; promote to 2k+ network; record and repurpose into 2–3 clip shorts.
Pitch 4–5 bylined articles to tier-1 publications (e.g., BT Investor, TechInAsia, PropertyGuru Insights); draft, editing, publication coordination.
Create 1 downloadable whitepaper ('State of PropTech 2024: Market Snapshot') from aggregate data; use as lead magnet; promote via paid LinkedIn ads (SGD 1.5k budget).
Weekly LinkedIn engagement: repost, comment on 5–7 industry posts; build personal brand authority through thoughtful dialogue.
kpis: 8 LinkedIn articles published; avg. 500+ views each, 25+ meaningful comments; 1 article achieves 1.5k+ views.
4 thought leadership videos: 8k+ combined views, 3.5%+ engagement rate.
1 Fireside Chat: 200+ live attendees, 500+ replay views, 2–3 viral clip shorts ≥ 50k views each.
4–5 bylined articles in tier-1 publications (confirmed placements); 20k+ aggregate audience reach.
CEO personal LinkedIn: 40% follower growth (e.g., 10k → 14k); 1–2 speaking invitations from industry conferences (post-campaign follow-up).
Whitepaper lead magnet: 35–45 qualified leads (name, email, company, intent signal); 8% conversion rate on landing page.
